title: gbuild verification-process baseline
description: Structural contract for Tests/process-baseline.json, the versioned artefact that records how well the verification process itself is doing. This schema exists so the `$schema` reference in the baseline resolves to a real file that is actually enforced: until now the pointer named a path on a repository that does not exist, so nothing validated the file and a structural regression in the baseline would have shipped silently. Tests/Hygiene.Tests.ps1 ('the process baseline is versioned and structurally valid') now validates the baseline against THIS file, which makes the pointer load-bearing instead of decorative.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, relative to the baseline.

generatedAtUtc.description: When this baseline was measured. ISO-8601 UTC.

generatedBy.description: The command that produced these numbers. A baseline with no reproducible producer is an aspiration, not a measurement.

failedAllowed.description: Hard-zero. A baseline that tolerates failures is not a gate.

skippedMaxAllowed.description: The deliberate, reviewed skip allowance. Tests/Run-CoreTests.ps1 -StrictSkips - which every CI job passes - is enforced against THIS number rather than against zero. It was previously 'any skip fails', which cannot hold alongside a baseline that records skips: every run failed for a reason unrelated to the code under test and a genuine new skip was lost in the noise. Lowering this value is the ratchet; never raise it to make a red run green.

skipEnforcement.description: Records which artefact -StrictSkips is measured against, so the authority for the gate is stated in the baseline rather than only in runner code.

killedByInfraAllowed.description: Hard-zero. A scope killed by infra (EDR, OOM) must never be counted as passing.

floorPercent.description: Ratchet floor. Raise only, never lower.

gates.description: Describe blocks across Tests/Hygiene.Tests.ps1 + Tests/ModuleHygiene.Tests.ps1. Enforced against the real count by Tests/Hygiene.Tests.ps1, so this number cannot drift away from reality again.

gatesAudit.description: Why the gate count is what it is, and which gate was previously blind.

dependencyGraphAudit.description: How the module dependency graph is derived and what it now validates.

deadExportedFunctionsAllowed.description: Hard-zero. Dead public surface is only acceptable via deliberatePublicApi.

deliberatePublicApi.description: Module::Function entries that have zero production call sites BY DESIGN. Kept in sync with the dead-export gate by an explicit test.

unreferencedConstantsAllowed.description: Hard-zero. A declared-but-unread constant is dead configuration.

adoptionFloor.description: One entry per adoption-ratio class measured by Modules/ProcessMetrics.psm1. A class may not exist here unless the metric measures it, and the metric may not measure one that is absent here.

minAdoption.description: Adoption RATIO, not a defect count, so it stays comparable across refactors. Raise as the backlog shrinks; never lower to make a red run green.

metric.description: What is actually counted. Must describe the fingerprint precisely: a metric whose description does not match its implementation is how stringHashDelegation reported 100% while two real duplicates shipped.

adoptionFloorNote.description: States the raise-only rule explicitly, so the intent survives whoever edits the file next.

qpm.description: Quality Performance Management gate inputs: the window change-failure rate ceiling over Tests/TestResults/process-trend.jsonl and the ledger contract for escaped defects. The build reads maxChangeFailureRate and windowSamples; the rest is recorded evidence for auditors. RATCHET: lower maxChangeFailureRate as the rate falls; never raise it to make a red run green.

platformPathLiteralExemptions.description: PATTERN-scoped, never file-scoped. A file-scoped list silently exempts every future violation added to that file.

pattern.description: The exact offending fragment. Names it precisely so a DIFFERENT backslash added to the same file is still caught.
